**EMI from this agreement**

The EMI (Equated Monthly Installment) from this agreement is $313.36. This is the amount you are required to pay each month, as specified in Clause 5 of the agreement. According to the payment instructions, all monthly payments of $313.36 must be made by electronic transfer (ACH/online payment) to the Lender's designated bank account on or before the 8th day of each month, beginning November 8, 2025.
